subject: Discovery recap + next steps: rotating deep-dive windows
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps: rotating deep-dive windows

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of proposed next steps so we can lock in a technical deep-dive.

What I heard:
- Harbor Health is prioritizing low-latency patient-facing features and needs predictable per-token cost for high-throughput inference.
- Primary data concerns: audit logs, key management, and retention policy for test datasets.
- Ideal timeline: pilot before end of Q1; decision-maker attendees for deep-dive: Alex (ops) + one platform engineer.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute technical deep-dive focusing on integration pattern (private VPC option), performance profile for your workload, and a short sandbox walkthrough. Because your team spans US/EU/APAC and Alex mentioned rotating on-call coverage, we usually run those deep-dives on a rotating timeband so each region sees an amenable time once every 2 weeks. Suggested rotating windows (all times local anchors):

- US morning slot: 09:00–11:00 PT (good for west-coast engineering)
- EU late-afternoon slot: 17:00–19:00 CET (works for central EU ops)
- APAC morning slot: 10:00–12:00 SGT (friendly for APAC engineers)

Options for cadence:
- Option A: Weekly deep-dive on a fixed window you pick (we pick a permanent slot).
- Option B: Bi-weekly rotation across the three windows so each region alternates ownership (we rotate host: US -> EU -> APAC).

If Option B looks good I propose we assign owners on our side: Vivek (US), Ben (EU), Priyom (APAC) so there is clear single-point contact per run. I attached a short discovery recap and a one-page .ics with the proposed windows for quick import.

Can you confirm which cadence you prefer and a handful of good days/times over the next two weeks? If you want, Alex and I can do a 30-minute pre-call to scope the agenda ahead of the deep-dive.

Thanks — I’ll wait for a thumbs up and will send a calendar invite when you confirm.

—
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128
Redwood Inference
